body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung unveiled its new premium phone ‘Serenata’ during KES 2007, which was co-developed by Bang & Olufsen, Danish home theater designer. Compared to the Serene, the first version of the two companies’ partnership, the Serenata puts more emphasis on music with a dedicated music key which brings up a music player, and a touch-sensitive scroll wheel used to pick tracks as well as place calls. It is scheduled to be launched in early November throughout B&O stores in Europe and cell phone retailers. No words on pricing yet.
